pulseq_element.pulseq.script:
# Pulseq sequence file
# Created by PyPulseq
# PARAMETERS_JSON_START
# {
#   "delay":    { "type": "int",   "default": 5000, "min": 0,"max": 1000000, "step": 10, "unit": "us", "pulseq_value": 5000, "pulseq_unit": "us", "description":"delay"  }
# }
# PARAMETERS_JSON_END

[VERSION]
major 1
minor 4
revision 2

[DEFINITIONS]
AdcRasterTime 1e-07 
BlockDurationRaster 1e-05 
GradientRasterTime 0.0001 
RadiofrequencyRasterTime 1e-06 
TotalDuration {(delay)*1e-6} 

# Format of blocks:
# NUM DUR RF  GX  GY  GZ  ADC  EXT
[BLOCKS]
1  {int((delay)/10)}   0   1   0   0  0  0

# Format of trapezoid gradients:
# id amplitude rise flat fall delay
# ..      Hz/m   us   us   us    us
[TRAP]
 1 0 0 {delay} 0   0
